title: Unscripted: What do children understand about computers that adults have forgotten?
abstract:
Linda Liukas writes books that explain computers to six-year-olds. Barbara Oakley studies how people learn, and why so many of us decide early that we're bad at something.

Two people who spend a lot of time with beginners, talking about what gets lost on the way to being an expert.

No slides, no script, and no idea where it ends up.

speakers.name: Barbara Oakley
speakers.role_company: Professor of Engineering at Oakland University

speakers.name: Linda Liukas
speakers.role_company: Author and co-founder of Rails Girls
